subject: general
question: The New York Times won the Pulitzer Prize, 2021, for which work in the prestigious Public Service category?

options.text: The coverage of the death of George Floyd
The coverage of the coronavirus pandemic

solution:
The correct answer is **__The coverage of the coronavirus pandemic.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Pulitzer Prize is awarded within the **United States for excellence in journalism** in various categories. It was First awarded in 1917.
 
• The New York Times won the '**Pulitzer Prize, 2021**' in the prestigious public service category for its detailed, data-filled reporting on the pandemic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pulitzer prize **is an award for achievement in newspapers, magazines, online journalism, literature, and musical composition within the United States.
 
• The Pulitzer prize administration award prize across **22 categories in Journalism, and art each year.**
 
• Columbia University administers it**.**
